name: hand-grief
description: User reports grief after losing a parent. Tests grief topic detection, reflective listening approach.

message.content: R|C=0.92|V=It has been three months since my mom died and I still cannot stop crying every day

R|C=0.86
Three months is both an eternity and the blink of an eye when you are grieving someone who shaped your life. There is no calendar for this kind of pain — tears are not a sign of weakness, they are proof of love still looking for where to go.

What is one memory of her that makes you smile even through the tears?

Jakie jest jedno wspomnienie o niej, które sprawia, że się uśmiechasz — nawet przez łzy?
